svg.title: Whole Lab · CyberAlchemy Lab concept map
svg.desc: A need directs work. Saved records preserve the result. Selected information prepares a temporary agent session, and evidence supports assessment and later learning. Select a node for its role, example and connections. Arrows are explanatory role connections.

g.title: The chosen response to a need identifies goals and work with stated limits.
Work results provide observations and measurements for assessment.
Assessed evidence can support advice for later work under stated conditions.
Record-format requirements refer to defined meanings.
Records use their selected type’s required format and constraints.
Governed project records contribute to durable Project State.
The applicable authority rules determine which definition versions are accepted for a purpose.
Specific record versions and their connections can be represented as graph points and lines in a selected consistent view.
A selected graph view can contribute to the information prepared for a task. Each view has its own requirements.
The session uses selected task information and its relevant connected model, with source versions identified.
Saved Project State supplies records and source versions for the task’s selected information.
Evidence and assessments are saved records with their conditions and sources identified.
The agent performs the assigned work within its permissions and rules.
